description: This file defines an interface IOnDeserialized for notification after deserialization, and an abstract class DeserializationContext providing context during deserialization in the Orleans.Serialization namespace.

classes.name: DeserializationContext
classes.description: Abstract class providing deserialization context, including service provider and runtime client information.

methods.name: OnDeserialized
methods.description: Method to be implemented by classes to handle post-deserialization notification, accepting a DeserializationContext parameter.
